items.question: Where did Kara Dunn play college basketball?
items.answer: Kara Dunn played at Georgia Tech, where she made the All-ACC First Team in 2025 and the Second Team in 2024, then transferred to USC for her senior season. At USC in 2025-26 she started all 32 games, averaged 15.2 points and 5.0 rebounds, and made the All-Big Ten Second Team.
